items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: He came to the band in Atlantic City while we were engaged on the boardwalk there... When Scott Joplin walked out and brought his rag. The Maple Leaf Rag.

ctx.x: Well, anyway, I read that book years ago.
I'm just trying to think about another great, yeah, Scott Joplin. Oh, yes.
